meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: the "Overview" tab opens
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab, where Vendor A has already submitted a bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ event.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time bid rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open the Overview tab from the RFQ project page.
Verify that the Overview tab opened successfully.
Verify that the overview content includes the Participation Summary section.
Verify that participant totals are shown in the Overview content.
Verify that active participant information is shown.
Confirm that opening the Overview tab did not produce an application error.
